findings: get_prismatic_vla passes load_for_training=False; load_vla passes freeze_weights=True; inherited from_pretrained calls requires_grad_(False) and eval(). This is static call-path evidence, not a logged runtime training flag.
get_prismatic_vla_action converts the supplied image to RGB and conditionally applies center_crop; center_crop defaults false for the original checkpoint whose image_aug is false.
predict_action decodes tokens and applies stored q01/q99 normalization before returning output[action]. Native values are not logits/probabilities.
patch_model_for_generation only adds a transformers cache compatibility attribute.
Evaluator writes the pre-action RGB to MP4 before the environment action, without a second image flip; video encoding is lossy.
limits: No claim that original runtime model.training, token IDs, generation configuration or all preprocessing pixels were saved and replay-verified.
No proof of physical arm response equivalence, equal graspability or causal equivalence of source/target image histories.
